reasons.plausibility: Substituting Hf with Zr to reduce density while maintaining similar microstructure and mechanical properties is scientifically sound, though minor phase stability and property trade-offs are possible.
reasons.testability: They propose a clear series of (Hf_xZr_1−x)MoTaTiZr alloys with well-defined acceptance criteria for mechanical properties under specified conditions, making the hypothesis straightforward to test.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the challenge of lowering density in HfMoTaTiZr without losing mechanical performance, offering specific guidance on composition variations and measurable acceptance thresholds.
